**FWJP** disables Amazon's security stack and spoofs your device identity so the app sees a fresh device on every reset. Works on Amazon Japan and Amazon South Africa (GBox).

**What it does:**
- Disables Kavach SDK (proxy/VPN/screenshot monitoring)
- Bypasses jailbreak, debugger, hook, and dylib detection
- Spoofs IDFV, IDFA, device serial, installId, and fraud metadata fingerprint
- Marketplace-aware locale + timezone (JP: `ja_JP`/Tokyo, SA: `en_ZA`/Johannesburg)
- CTCarrier spoofed to match marketplace (Vodacom/ZA or NTT DOCOMO/JP)
- Scrubs all GBox identity strings from UIDevice, NSBundle, and NSProcessInfo
- Patches `amzn-app-ctxt` and `amzn-app-id` cookies to strip all GBox fingerprints
- Japan/SA marketplace persists across Reset & Spoof wipes
- Floating overlay: live hook log, Reset & Spoof, Cookies, Step Recorder, Info, **Check & Copy Diagnostic**

- Full fingerprint audit: every GBox signal patched in one build
- Marketplace-aware locale + timezone — JP: `ja_JP`/`Asia/Tokyo`, SA: `en_ZA`/`Africa/Johannesburg`
- Restored installId spoof (`NA:mshop:<uuid>`) — intercepted at NSUserDefaults read; regenerated on wipe
- Restored IDFA spoof (`ASIdentifierManager`) — persistent, regenerated on wipe
- Restored CTCarrier spoof — Vodacom/ZA/655/01 for SA, NTT DOCOMO/JP/440/10 for Japan
- Restored `NSProcessInfo.physicalMemory` → 8 GB (iPhone 15 Pro)
- Scrubbed GBox from `UIDevice.name`, `UIDevice.model`, `NSProcessInfo.processName`, `NSBundle.bundleIdentifier`
- Restored `NSBundle` display-name hook (FWamz → Amazon Shopping)
- Restored `amzn-app-ctxt.scc` and `dm.pt` patches
- New **📋 Check & Copy Diagnostic** toolbar button — copies full report of every spoofed value, live cookies, carrier, locale, and bundle to clipboard

- Fixed `application.name` leaking as `FWamz` in MAES telemetry body — hooks `NSBundle` display name to return `Amazon Shopping`
- Patched `amzn-app-ctxt.scc`: GBox was sending `USA`; now derived from marketplace (`ZA` for SA, `JP` for Japan)
- Patched `amzn-app-ctxt.dm.pt`: GBox sent wrong top padding (`16`); corrected to `177` for iPhone 15 Pro Dynamic Island
- Spoofed `installId` (`NA:mshop:<uuid>`) — regenerated on every Reset & Spoof wipe; intercepted in NSUserDefaults reads
- Spoofed IDFA (`ASIdentifierManager`) — persistent UUID regenerated on wipe
- `NSProcessInfo.physicalMemory` now returns 8 GB consistent with iPhone 15 Pro
- `CTCarrier` spoofed to marketplace carrier (Vodacom/ZA for SA, NTT DOCOMO/JP for Japan)
- Pre-patches cookie cache at launch so the first MAES call goes out clean

- Fixed critical bug: `_patchAppIdCookie` was placed inside the `%hook` block, causing Logos to generate a truncated `setCookie:` method (hook was a complete no-op in 1.0.6/1.0.7)
- Both `amzn-app-ctxt` and `amzn-app-id` patches now fire correctly
- Fixed cold-start crash (nil guard on cookie value)
- `an`, `di.v`, `di.ca`, and `amzn-app-id` app name all patched on every write

- Fixed `amzn-app-ctxt` patch to look inside nested `di` dict for `v` and `ca` fields (Amazon moved them in the current app version)
- Added `amzn-app-id` cookie patch: replaces GBox app name with `Amazon Shopping`
- Both patches now cover South Africa (`amazon.co.za`) and Japan (`amazon.co.jp`) marketplaces

- Added `amzn-app-ctxt` cookie patch: intercepts cookie at write time and fixes `an` (app name), `v` (device model `Unknown_` prefix), `ca` (invalid carrier `--`)
- Hooks `NSHTTPCookieStorage` so patches apply on all paths including WKWebView

- Added Step Recorder: captures all Amazon HTTP traffic while enabled
- Overlay now has 4 buttons: Reset | Cookies | Steps | Info

- Cookie extractor: tap Cookies in the overlay to grab your session cookies and copy to clipboard
- Japan marketplace persistence: country/locale settings survive Reset & Spoof wipes
- 3-button overlay toolbar (Reset | Cookies | Info)

- Fixed startup deadlock caused by NSLocale hook locking during early ObjC init
- All hook bodies are now non-blocking (async log dispatch)

- Fixed floating overlay not appearing on iOS 16 (UIWindowScene fix)
- Added NSLocale hook to force amazon.co.jp instead of amazon.com
- Fixed panel presenter on iOS 13+

- Initial release
- Kavach SDK bypass
- Identity spoofing (IDFV, serial, fingerprint)
- Floating overlay with reset and device info
